fieldValues.title: Ask your AI to teach you
fieldValues.summary: Once connected, just ask your AI to teach you this editor. It finds the editor's start page by itself and can point at things on your screen as it explains them. If it doesn't, ask it to use its ui_help tool.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Start with ui_help (the start page); then teach one feature at a time, showing each with ui_highlight before you explain it.
